purpose: Verify professor creates a new course-associated draft quiz with required identity and duration
preconditions: Professor user authorized for course CS101
action_or_input: QuizService.create_quiz(title='Quiz 1', course_code='CS101', created_by='prof1', start_time=now+1d, end_time=now+2d, duration_minutes=30)
expected_result: Quiz created with status='DRAFT', title='Quiz 1', course_code='CS101', and total_marks=0.0

purpose: Verify prohibited post-activation editing of quiz definition is blocked
preconditions: Quiz status is 'PUBLISHED' and availability has begun
action_or_input: Professor attempts to modify quiz title, duration, and course_code of active quiz
expected_result: ConflictError or validation error: Editing active quiz definition is prohibited

purpose: Verify validation failure leaves existing persisted quiz definition unchanged
preconditions: Valid draft quiz exists
action_or_input: Attempt to update quiz with invalid schedule (end_time earlier than start_time)
expected_result: ValueError raised; previous persisted quiz attributes remain unaltered

purpose: Verify professor adds new questions with marks and options to draft quiz
preconditions: Draft quiz exists
action_or_input: Create Question and link via QuizQuestion with order=1, marks=2.0
expected_result: Question linked to quiz; quiz.quiz_questions includes question with order=1 and marks=2.0

purpose: Verify professor edits and removes existing questions while quiz remains in draft
preconditions: Draft quiz with 2 linked questions
action_or_input: Remove question 2 from quiz and update question 1 marks to 4.0
expected_result: Question 2 removed; question 1 marks updated to 4.0 in quiz question set

purpose: Verify attaching image-based question content where supported
preconditions: Draft quiz
action_or_input: Create Question with image attachment URL or metadata in question_text
expected_result: Question created with image metadata preserved and retrievable

purpose: Verify unsupported or invalid question data is rejected and not committed
preconditions: Draft quiz
action_or_input: Attempt to link question with negative default marks or invalid question type
expected_result: Validation error raised; invalid question is not committed to quiz

purpose: Verify storing, searching/filtering, and reusing Question Bank content
preconditions: QuestionBank exists for course CS101
action_or_input: Create Question in bank, query get_question_banks(), and link bank question to new quiz
expected_result: Question stored in bank and successfully linked into new quiz with order and marks

purpose: Verify configuring duration, start/end boundaries, and assessment rules
preconditions: Draft quiz
action_or_input: QuizService.create_quiz with start_time, end_time, duration_minutes=45, description='Rules'
expected_result: Quiz schedule and duration saved successfully

purpose: Verify invalid schedule configuration is rejected without replacing prior configuration
preconditions: Draft quiz with valid start and end times
action_or_input: Attempt to update schedule where duration_minutes=-10
expected_result: ValueError raised: duration must be > 0; prior valid duration retained

purpose: Verify publishing configured draft quiz transitions status to PUBLISHED
preconditions: Draft quiz with configured schedule and questions
action_or_input: QuizService.publish_quiz(quiz.id)
expected_result: Quiz status transitions to 'PUBLISHED'

purpose: Verify incomplete draft quiz (no questions or empty schedule) cannot be published
preconditions: Draft quiz with 0 questions attached
action_or_input: Attempt to publish quiz with 0 questions
expected_result: Validation error or ConflictError: Quiz cannot be published without questions

purpose: Verify closing an active/published quiz transitions status to CLOSED
preconditions: Quiz in PUBLISHED status
action_or_input: transition_quiz(quiz, 'CLOSED'); quiz.save()
expected_result: Quiz status updated to 'CLOSED'

purpose: Verify quiz deletion is blocked when student attempts already exist
preconditions: Quiz has existing QuizAttempt records
action_or_input: Attempt to delete Quiz record from database or API
expected_result: ProtectedError or ConflictError: Cannot delete quiz with associated student attempts

purpose: Verify student dashboard lists published/closed quizzes and displays pre-start info
preconditions: Published quiz with 2 questions exists
action_or_input: Call get_student_quizzes('student_1') and get_quiz_by_id(quiz.id)
expected_result: Quiz returned with pre-start metadata (title, duration_minutes, total_marks, questions)

purpose: Verify ineligible student is not exposed to quizzes for unenrolled courses
preconditions: Student enrolled in CS101; quiz belongs to ME301
action_or_input: Student requests quiz list for enrolled courses
expected_result: Ineligible quiz ME301 is omitted from student's available quiz list

purpose: Verify eligible student starts timed quiz attempt within availability window
preconditions: Quiz in PUBLISHED status, now is between start_time and end_time
action_or_input: QuizService.start_attempt(quiz.id, 'student_1')
expected_result: QuizAttempt created in 'IN_PROGRESS' status with started_at recorded and empty answer slots

purpose: Verify attempt start is blocked when current time is outside availability window
preconditions: Quiz in PUBLISHED status, but start_time is in the future
action_or_input: QuizService.start_attempt(quiz.id, 'student_1')
expected_result: ValueError raised: Quiz is not currently available for attempt

purpose: Verify attempt start is blocked when student has exhausted permitted attempts limit
preconditions: Quiz configured with permitted_attempts=1; student already submitted attempt 1
action_or_input: Student invokes start_attempt for attempt 2
expected_result: ValueError raised: Permitted attempt limit exhausted

purpose: Verify pre-start background application check reports unclosed unauthorized tasks
preconditions: Student system has disallowed background applications running
action_or_input: Invoke pre-start environment verification check
expected_result: System identifies unauthorized processes and blocks attempt start until resolved

purpose: Verify student answers questions during active attempt and responses persist
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS status
action_or_input: QuizService.save_answer(attempt.id, question.id, {'choice': 'OptA'})
expected_result: StudentAnswer.submitted_answer updated to {'choice': 'OptA'} and persisted

purpose: Verify student can leave questions unanswered during active attempt if permitted
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS on quiz with 3 questions
action_or_input: Student answers question 1 and leaves questions 2 and 3 with empty submitted_answer
expected_result: Questions 2 and 3 remain recorded with submitted_answer={} without error

purpose: Verify linear navigation restriction prevents navigating back to previous questions
preconditions: Quiz configured with allow_back_navigation=False; student answered question 1 and advanced to 2
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit update to question 1 answer
expected_result: HTTP 400 Bad Request: Modifying previous questions is prohibited in linear mode

purpose: Verify manual submission transitions attempt to evaluated and records submission timestamp
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS status with answers saved
action_or_input: QuizService.submit_attempt(attempt.id, autosubmit=False)
expected_result: Attempt status transitions to EVALUATED, submitted_at is set, and total_score computed

purpose: Verify student can cancel submission confirmation and resume active attempt
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS, student presented with submission confirmation dialog
action_or_input: Student dismisses confirmation modal without confirming submission
expected_result: Attempt remains in IN_PROGRESS status with timer and answer editing active

purpose: Verify attempt is automatically submitted when configured duration expires
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS, current time exceeds started_at + duration_minutes
action_or_input: QuizService.save_answer(attempt.id, question.id, {'choice': 'OptB'})
expected_result: ValueError raised: Time expired, and attempt is automatically submitted and evaluated

purpose: Verify automatic scoring of objective questions upon submission
preconditions: Attempt submitted with correct answer for MCQ_SINGLE and MCQ_MULTI questions
action_or_input: QuizService.submit_attempt(attempt.id)
expected_result: Autograded score calculated and assigned to each answer; attempt total_score equals sum of marks

purpose: Verify mixed quiz with subjective questions retains pending subjective review status
preconditions: Attempt submitted on quiz with objective and subjective (essay) questions
action_or_input: QuizService.submit_attempt(attempt.id)
expected_result: Attempt status set to 'SUBMITTED' or 'UNDER_REVIEW' pending professor subjective grading

purpose: Verify AI-assisted evaluation provides suggestions and professor confirms final marks
preconditions: Submitted attempt with subjective SHORT_ANSWER question
action_or_input: Trigger AI evaluation for subjective answer, then professor confirms final score
expected_result: AI provides suggested score; professor confirms and final score is updated

purpose: Verify professor manually grades subjective response and provides feedback
preconditions: Submitted attempt with student answer
action_or_input: QuizService.override_score(answer.id, override_score=Decimal('5.0'), feedback='Excellent explanation')
expected_result: override_score=5.0 and feedback saved; attempt total_score updated

purpose: Verify professor releases evaluated quiz results to students
preconditions: Quiz with evaluated attempts exists
action_or_input: QuizService.toggle_release(quiz.id, 'grades_released', True)
expected_result: quiz.grades_released is set to True

purpose: Verify un-evaluated quiz results cannot be released to students
preconditions: Quiz with pending subjective submissions not yet evaluated
action_or_input: Attempt to release grades for un-evaluated quiz
expected_result: Validation error or ConflictError: Cannot release grades while submissions remain un-evaluated

purpose: Verify professor releases answer key and student views correct answers
preconditions: Quiz with answer_key_released=True
action_or_input: QuizService.toggle_release(quiz.id, 'answer_key_released', True)
expected_result: quiz.answer_key_released updated to True; correct answers visible in quiz detail

purpose: Verify student is blocked from viewing correct answers before answer key release
preconditions: Quiz with answer_key_released=False
action_or_input: Student queries GET /quizzing/api/quizzes/{id}/
expected_result: Question options and text returned, but correct_answer field is masked/omitted

purpose: Verify professor can retrieve all attempts for grading and monitoring
preconditions: Quiz with 2 submitted attempts
action_or_input: Call get_quiz_attempts_for_grading(quiz.id)
expected_result: Returns list of QuizAttempt objects for the quiz prefetching answers and questions

purpose: Verify lifecycle transitions from DRAFT to PUBLISHED to CLOSED
preconditions: Draft quiz exists
action_or_input: transition_quiz(quiz, 'PUBLISHED'), then transition_quiz(quiz, 'CLOSED')
expected_result: Quiz status transitions successfully through allowed sequence
